item.title: Apple changes name of Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’ in maps app
item.description:
Apple has changed the label on Lake Ontario to " Lake America ," according to an Axios review of Apple Maps on Tuesday afternoon. Why it matters: Apple is the second major digital map provider to make the switch. Google did so over the weekend — at least for those in the United States. Driving the news: President Trump had reportedly asked Apple to make the switch last week, Department of the Interior Secretary Doug Burgum told Fox Business on Monday. Apple's decision comes less than a week after the president's executive order to rename the body of water along the U.S.-Canada border. The company also eventually changed the Gulf of Mexico to " Gulf of America " and Mount Denali to Mount McKinley last year when Trump renamed those sites via an executive order on the first day of his second term.
